item.title: CVE-2026-63417: Logging Redactor: PII data in str/repr of non primitive objects was not being redacted
item.description:
Severity: high. Impact PII data in str/repr of non primitive objects was not being redacted, leading to leakage of PII in logs that should have been redacted for custom `__str__` and `__repr__` functions
Patches The problem has been patched in version 0.0.7.
Workarounds None without patching.

item.title: Web3Auth Flaw Exploited to Steal Keplr Crypto, Provider Empties Other Wallets for Safety
item.description: Some people who set up a Keplr crypto wallet with their Google or Apple account have had money stolen by an attacker. Keplr uses a company called Web3Auth to run that Google and Apple sign-in. The attacker used a security flaw at that company to reach the wallets, both companies said late last week.
